name: Harlan Creek Substation
access_notes: Gravel access road off county route. Gate code in dispatch system. Cell signal weak inside control house; one bar at the gate.
surroundings: Open farmland. Exposed ridge site; high wind and icing history.

name: Quarry Road Substation
access_notes: Shares entrance road with an active limestone quarry. Heavy truck traffic weekdays 6am-6pm.
surroundings: Adjacent (approx. 300 m) to an active limestone quarry with crushing operations. Blasting schedule posted at quarry office.
